title: Events + event detail
one_line: Limited-time events list and one event's rules and rewards.

anatomy.spec: Events hub: bg_menu_emboss, nameplate EVENTS, rows (bible 5.7) of active/upcoming events with a countdown each.
Standard NX Card popup: event banner, rules, reward ladder as wells, a CTA (PLAY or CLAIM depending on state).

copy.title: EVENTS
copy.empty: No events right now. Check back soon.

states: No events - empty state, never a blank panel
Event ended, rewards missed - honest, no guilt copy
data: Event definitions and progress - server-driven so events can be added without a build (remote config).
do_not: Do not show a blank panel with no events - use the empty state.
Do not hard-code event content client-side if remote config is available - events should be addable without a build.
acceptance: Empty state renders correctly when there are no events.
steps: 2. Swap the ground and add the nameplate/corners to both list and detail.
3. Ensure the empty state exists and looks intentional, not broken.
5. Capture active, empty and ended states. Postflight.
prompt:
Polish the Ludo NX Events hub and Event Detail popup.

Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md, UI_BIBLE/LUDO_NX_UI_BIBLE.md sections 5.7 and 5.22, and this whole file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json.

Swap the ground to bg_menu_emboss, add a proper EVENTS nameplate and Lucky Six corners, and make sure an empty state (bible 5.22) shows when there are no active events - never a blank panel. Event Detail is a standard NX Card popup with a banner, the rules, a reward ladder in wells, and a context-appropriate action (PLAY while active, CLAIM once ended).

Follow the 'steps' array. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list.
